name: BOB Tools
description:
BOB Tools is a mobile-first business data platform: forms, tables and folders your team fills in from their phones, with views, share links and documents on top. This connector gives Claude access to your BOB workspace, so you can work with that data in plain language instead of tapping through screens.

With it Claude can query and aggregate records ("how many orders came in last week, by status"), create and restructure forms, fields and views, organise files and folders, publish public share links, view and attach the images stored on records, and build block-based documents and dashboards from live data.

You connect with your own BOB account over OAuth, and Claude sees exactly the companies and files that account can already access — nothing more. Read-only tools are marked as such, and every tool that changes or deletes data is annotated so Claude asks before acting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BOB Tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BOB Tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.bob.tools/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BOB Tools MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BOB Tools provides these MCP tools: bob_company, bob_docs, bob_fields, bob_files, bob_get_account, bob_images, bob_records, bob_shares, and bob_views.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BOB Tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BOB Tools in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does BOB Tools MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BOB Tools requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BOB Tools is developed by BOB Tools LLP. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
